description: Receive and reply to Weixin messages through Tencent's iLink Bot API. Media encryption requires the Node.js runtime.

fields.label: Bot Token
fields.placeholder: Paste the botToken from the QR login example
fields.description: The secret bot token returned after QR pairing. Run `node examples/weixin-bot-login.ts` locally to obtain it, and do not share it.

fields.label: Bot Account ID
fields.placeholder: Paste the accountId from the QR login example
fields.description: The ilink_bot_id returned together with the bot token after QR pairing.

actions.name: download_media
actions.description: Download and decrypt one image, voice, video, or file item returned by get_updates.
providerPermissions: Download media received by the connected Weixin bot

inputSchema.description: A media item returned inside a Weixin message item_list.

sizeBytes.description: The decrypted file size in bytes.

file.description: Decrypted media stored in local transit storage.

actions.name: get_updates
actions.description: Long-poll for inbound Weixin bot messages. Pass the returned cursor to the next call to avoid receiving the same updates again.
providerPermissions: Receive messages sent to the connected Weixin bot

cursor.description: The cursor returned by the previous get_updates call.

message_id.description: The message identifier returned by Weixin.

from_user_id.description: The Weixin user that sent the message.

create_time_ms.description: The message creation time in milliseconds.

message_type.description: The message sender type reported by Weixin.

message_state.description: The message lifecycle state reported by Weixin.

context_token.description: The conversation token to pass back when replying.

item_list.description: The text or media items carried by the message.

items.description: A Weixin iLink message, including its sender, content items, and reply context.

anyOf.description: The cursor to pass to the next get_updates call.

nextCursor.description: The cursor to pass to the next get_updates call.

anyOf.description: The next long-poll duration suggested by Weixin.

longPollingTimeoutMs.description: The next long-poll duration suggested by Weixin.

outputSchema.description: Inbound messages and the state needed for the next long-poll.

actions.name: send_media
actions.description: Encrypt, upload, and send an image, video, or file from local transit storage.
providerPermissions: Upload and send media as the connected Weixin bot

toUserId.description: The target user ID from an inbound Weixin message.

contextToken.description: The context_token from the inbound message being answered.

mediaType.description: How Weixin should present the file.

file.description: A file already uploaded to local transit storage.

caption.description: Optional text sent as a separate message before the media.

inputSchema.description: A transit file and its Weixin reply context.

anyOf.description: The server-assigned message identifier when returned.

messageId.description: The server-assigned message identifier when returned.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Send a text reply from the connected Weixin bot to a user or conversation.
providerPermissions: Send messages as the connected Weixin bot

toUserId.description: The target user ID from an inbound Weixin message.

contextToken.description: The context_token from the inbound message being answered.

inputSchema.description: A text message and its Weixin reply context.

anyOf.description: The server-assigned message identifier when returned.

messageId.description: The server-assigned message identifier when returned.

actions.name: send_typing
actions.description: Start or stop the typing indicator for a Weixin conversation.
providerPermissions: Update typing status as the connected Weixin bot

userId.description: The Weixin user ID from an inbound message.

contextToken.description: The context_token from the inbound message.

status.description: Whether to start or stop the typing indicator.
The typing state sent to Weixin.

outputSchema.description: The typing state accepted by Weixin.
